summary: Barclays PLC filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing documents for an ordinary senior debt issuance: a Pricing Agreement dated October 29, 2026 with Barclays Capital Inc. covering 5.674% fixed-to-floating senior callable notes due 2030, 5.918% notes due 2032 and 6.367% notes due 2037, plus the related Twenty-Third Supplemental Indenture and global security forms dated November 5, 2026. No equity, ownership stake, premium or change-of-control terms appear. This is a standard shelf takedown of investment-grade bank paper, not a special situation; watch only spread and call features.
